reuse.why: Uses the existing getBudgetActionCategories policy, whose includeHiddenCategories/includeHiddenGroups options already existed, so the change is pure plumbing through every month-wide action including copyPreviousMonth.

duplication.why: No rule is duplicated, but the mapping `{ includeHiddenCategories, includeHiddenGroups: includeHiddenCategories }` is repeated in all six actions.

placement.why: The decision stays in the shared eligibility function in budget/actions.ts; actions only pass the request flag.

scope.why: Only the flag on the six actions and a test extension.

maintainability.why: Easy to own; a small helper turning the request flag into the policy object would remove the six repeated literals.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions go through getBudgetActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated policy literal in each action of budget/actions.ts is a visible repetition of argument plumbing, not disguised logic.
